pages.title: Fisher Price Classic Toys - Classic TV Radio
pages.description: First introduced in 1959, the Fisher Price TV Radio has delighted children for generations. Wind the knob to hear the endearing Farmer-in-the-Dell melody while whimsical scenes scroll across the window of the brightly lithographed case with 50's and 60's era graphics. Ages 18 months+
